scope: Production binding of actual default MaterialDef model shader/textures and packed model/baked lighting. Original shader sources, saved fields and assets remain unchanged; scene probe/light grid and Vulkan backend are adapters, not full original Model/Metal/game parity.

binding.scope: Original terrain/skirt GLSL, real packed geometry/material textures with declared gamma/mip handling and supported anisotropy (16x preview request), recovered float32 shader time and three-layer scroll accumulation. Explicit zero sampled wind field with original texture drift; full EnvironmentForces global noise/local winds/rails remain pending. Shared float32 HDR color/depth and linear decal/skirt blending. Main material viewport feeds the cloud depth/FogUpsample/MotionGen/MotionDilate/TemporalAa/Tonemap chain. PNG area-filtered mip generation and anisotropy strength remain preview adapters, not original exporter/Metal parity. Scene probe, point lights/shadows, water/puddle, startup events, bloom/motion and original Metal per-draw half quantization remain pending. Resource models use original GLSL, packed float3/color/SNORM normals/half4 UV pairs and remapped baked lighting. Original Model construction, visibility, RenderList sorting, animations and full scene services remain open.
